_readme: toil's hand-maintained record of each command's path, flags and output fields. toil must match every integration command here; see docs/command-contract.md for scope and the listed divergences. Edit it on purpose, in the same change as the commands it records.
_output: output lists the data shapes a command returns, one entry per place in the source that returns: field paths two levels deep, [] for an array element, a trailing ? for an optional field. opaque means the source types the data as any or unknown (usually a server response passed through), so there are no names to check.
_contractVersion: contractVersion is the version of this contract that toil reports in toil version and on every envelope's meta (CONTRACT_VERSION in src/core/envelope.ts; test/api.test.ts keeps them equal). It goes up by one with every breaking change to what this file records or to the envelope, and never for an additive one. See docs/command-contract.md, Changing the contract.
